skins.name: Explosive Blue Flame
skins.code: Witch Feast Role-Playing Script "Grimoire of Dark Law" Custom Line/Explosive Blue Flame
skins.description: She plays the role of the hero seeking the grimoire said to have been born amidst the Everlasting Flame. Whichever brave soul claims it can break through all rules and bindings.

skins.name: Heartwarming Baking
skins.description: Sure, it might look a little messy, with a few things not going as planned along the way. But he will serve the cake to you with a smile all the same, just like the life he wishes to lead, one filled with an affectionate warmth.

skins.name: Starry Night Sky
skins.code: Witch Feast Role-Playing Script "Grimoire of Dark Law" Custom Line/Starry Night Sky
skins.description: He plays the role of the guide showing the hero the way. The Golden Movement has long since faded, but the stars he shoots will forever point true north.

skins.name: The Shadow of the Dark Moon
skins.code: Witch Feast Role-Playing Script "Grimoire of Dark Law" Custom Line/The Shadow of the Dark Moon
skins.description: She plays the role of the witch guarding the grimoire. The tome is of no use to her. Instead, it is her sword that renders her unstoppable: 'Come, try to defeat me.'
skins.image: /six-star-skins/Degenbrecher - The Shadow of the Dark Moon.webp

skins.name: Witch's Swing
skins.code: Witch Feast Role-Playing Script "Grimoire of Dark Law" Custom Line/Witch's Swing
skins.description: She plays the role of the young witch brought by her dark mistress to gain some experience! Who says a witch's swing has to be a broom? A chainsaw works too!
